profile.jobTitle: Senior Specialist Front End Web Developer
profile.summary:
Skilled technology enthusiast with a passion for taking on new challenges. A self taught developer who learned development basics online in my spare time, decided to take a leap and pursue Georgia Tech's inaugural Full Stack Web Development Course to accelerate my growth in technology. I initially became interested in development after helping a friend design her mobile application, where I built wireframes and designed the flow of the application her startup was developing. From there, I focused on front end development and design, but have also gained experience with Node backend systems, MySQL, and testing suites like Cypress and Jest. Through my professional career I've focused on Front End Design and Development, though I've also consulted in larger roles for various friend's entrepreneurial projects.

In my spare time I enjoy helping friends with personal projects, and raising the World's Dumbest German Shepherds™.
